summary: Fresh-run first pass on the SwiftPaxos/EPaxos replica (go_module, package ./epaxos). Produced a preflight-valid research product: a usable partial map (map.json, ConsensusAuditSpec v1) plus sourced feedback. The map records A1 (qualified support for decision formation: startPhase1 pre-accept with conflict-derived seq/deps, PreAcceptReply fast-quorum commit vs Accept-majority fallback), A2 (per-instance ballot authority: acceptors reject lower ballots, makeBallot/recovery raise the ballot and reconstruct pre-accept state from the highest-VBallot Prepare replies), the A3 recovery / A5 execution / A6 persistence / A7 client supporting paths, and a core_overview whose connection explains how recovery re-enters the same formation paths, how CommittedUpTo and idempotent handleCommit bound re-decisions, and how old client proposals are carried through lb.clientProposals and re-proposed on a NOOP commit. Ten source ranges over epaxos/epaxos.go and epaxos/exec.go were cited. No defect or obligation is claimed: three local anomalies are retained as sourced unknowns (handlePreAccept's Status>=ACCEPTED & Cmds==nil branch writing InstanceSpace[LeaderId] instead of the handled instance; the textually identical class-3/class-4 guards in handlePrepareReply; the notInQuorum loop indexing possibleQuorum[tpar.AcceptorId] instead of [q]), alongside unread A4 membership/quorum-file selection and the A6 restart-replay path. Preflight validation against the live state returns valid=true; formal acceptance and execution remain the controller's.
